title: ...bring home a new indoor houseplant
desc: Keep your new houseplants thriving and prevent root rot or pests.
todos: Check plant leaves and soil thoroughly for signs of insects or pests.
Verify container has adequate drainage holes at bottom before watering.
Position plant according to light requirements (direct, indirect, or low light).
Water deeply only when top 1-2 inches of soil feel dry to touch.
Wipe dust off leaves periodically to maintain healthy photosynthesis.
